text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I visited the track to observe training—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Someone dropped a menko mask!
Whose is it~?

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, that hood's design
is ridiculously old-fashioned.

text_block_list.name: Chatty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I mean, honestly, it's so lame!
Ahahaha!
choice_data_list: (The mood doesn't seem great...)
(The mood's not looking too good...)

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my...
Ugh... what should I do...?
choice_data_list: (Looks like that girl is the owner, though...)

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: If no one claims it, I'll put it in the lost and found box!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm, wait, please...!!
That's........................ mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*chuckles*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she remained curled up in a slump
for quite some time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hey.
Not running today?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah... Sirius-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
My legs just felt kind of heavy...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you've got time to kill, come over here for a sec. That little pup peeking around over there, you too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, did you think I wouldn't notice?
If you're a good little puppy, wag your tail and follow me.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah...!
Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at a pool hall.
A few of Sirius Symboli's underclassmen were there, and right before our eyes was—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They just gathered up a bunch of random stuff.
—Take your pick and use whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Hoods?!
So many of them...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This is from a top luxury brand—wait, this one is too?!
I-Is it really okay for me to pick one...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Told you so. Hurry up and pick."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Choices come upon us suddenly.
...No matter what kind of "shackles" bind us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While her junior was picking out a hood,
Sirius Symboli muttered to herself.
choice_data_list: Is there something holding her back?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
......Tch,
what a pointless "shackle."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: At the end of the day, it's money. A stupid pair of shackles, but something she can't do anything about on her own.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Not even being able to stand in the ring because of something like that—I'd rather die than accept that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I see—so out of concern for your junior's situation, you created a scenario where they could "choose" for themselves.
choice_data_list: It reminded me once again why everyone looks up to you so much.
I was reminded once again why people look up to you.
I'm sure she'll be able to "choose for herself"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I see—so out of concern for your junior's situation, you created a scenario where they could "choose" for themselves.
choice_data_list: It reminded me once again why everyone looks up to you so much.
I was reminded once again why people look up to you.
I'm sure she'll be able to "choose for herself"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Flattery won't get you anywhere.
You're not my junior.
choice_data_list: Exactly! I'm not your junior, I'm your Trainer—
Exactly! I'm not your junior, I'm your Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You're a puppy. Am I right?
choice_data_list: Ah, so that's it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, a little while later—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah. I went out of my way to have them gathered.
It'd be a problem if it weren't.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She's free right now. She knows best
what she ought to do.
choice_data_list: (...That's a nice look on her face.)
(...What a wonderful expression she has.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, a little while later—

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpai—I've made up my mind. I'm going to stick with this after all.
choice_data_list: (Is that the original menko...?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh. And the reason is?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Actually, these blinkers were passed down from my grandmother to my mother, and from my mother to me.

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: When I really thought about it, I realized this is what's truly important to me. So—I choose this!
choice_data_list: (I see... So that's the situation.)
(I see... so that's the situation.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph.
So she chose her pride, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Then prove your strength.
Deliver results so overwhelming that no one will dare laugh."

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I will definitely become stronger...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in her eyes as she looked at her junior,
a brilliant light shone, as if proud of that very choice.
